newsitem.title: UK: British Post Office H1 pretax profit 230 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: British Post Office H1 pretax profit 230 mln stg.

text.p: Britain's Post Office said on Monday that its pretax profit for the six months to September 26, 1996 rose to 230 million stg from 170 million for the same period in the previous year.
The Post Office's turnover rose to 3.007 billion stg from 2.91 bln stg, it said in a statement.
It said Royal Mail made a pretax profit of 216 million stg while its Counters arm -- its retail side -- made a pretax profit of two million stg.
The parcel service, Parcelforce, made an operating loss during the period of 13 million stg.
